name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor with AI Writer, Auto Internal Linker, Broken Link Checker, Find & Replace & Analytics
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost is the industry-leading AI-driven productivity suite for professional bloggers, SEO agencies, and content creators. It acts as the ultimate alternative to Classic Editor and a powerful TinyMCE alternative, transforming the default WordPress editor into a high-octane content machine, eliminating the need for multiple heavy plugins.

Built by DominoPress, this toolkit provides a distraction-free environment where AI does the heavy lifting—from generating full SEO-optimized articles to advanced semantic internal linking. Stop switching between tabs; bring the power of GPT-4 directly to your editor.

👉 Unlock the Full Power of DominoPost PRO Here

💎 DominoPost PRO: The AI Evolution

Upgrade your content game with the DominoPost PRO Addon, featuring our most advanced automation engines:

  • ⚡ AI Smart Internal Interlinker: Automatically scans your site and inserts high-relevance internal links with perfect anchor text. Double your page views and boost SEO in seconds.
  • 🌐 Smart AI External Link Placement: Paste any external URL and let the AI find the perfect context-aware spot to insert it naturally.
  • ✨ AI Smart Rewrite (Magic Wand): Select any text and instantly paraphrase it with 4 professional tones (Friendly, Creative, Professional, Concise).
  • ❓ AI FAQ Schema Generator: Generate beautiful FAQ blocks with automated JSON-LD Schema to dominate Google’s “People Also Ask” sections.
  • ✍️ 1-Click AI Grammar Fixer: Instantly detect and fix grammatical errors across your entire post with a single click.
  • 🎯 Focus Keyword Optimization: Automatically optimize your article’s keyword density and placement for maximum search visibility.
  • 📦 Premium AI Interface: Experience the “Scroll & Review” bar to verify AI links before publishing, plus our signature tech-inspired scanning animations.
  • ⚡ Google Analytics PRO: Unlock advanced Events Analytics, real-time E-Commerce Revenue tracking, and powerful Date Comparisons to see seasonal traffic trends.

🚀 DominoPost FREE: Essential Productivity Suite

Get started with our lightweight, high-performance toolkit for every writer:

  • ⚡ Pro Table of Contents (TOC): 4 stunning styles (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed) with smooth-scrolling and live preview. Superior SEO and UX out of the box.
  • 📊 Google Analytics 4 Dashboard: Track real-time active users, page views, bounce rate, top landing pages, traffic sources, and audience devices directly in your WP dashboard.
  • 🤖 Content Assistant: A power-dashboard featuring 1-click tools for Blog Post Ideas, Outlines, Summaries, Meta Generators, and FAQ generators.
  • 📈 Google Search Console Dashboard: Real-time GSC performance tracking to monitor impressions, clicks, CTR, and keyword rankings natively in WordPress.
  • ✍️ AI Content Writer (Standard): Supports OpenAI, OpenRouter, Google Gemini (Default), Groq (Meta Llama), and Cerebras AI with high-speed streaming article generation.
  • 🔍 Google Keyword Research: Real-time related keyword suggestions tool directly in the AI Writer modal to find high-intent search queries.
  • 🕵️‍♂️ Site-Wide Broken Link Checker: Now seamlessly located inside the Tools Menu for real-time site audit.
  • 🔍 Bulk Title Editor Suite: Effortlessly perform title suffix additions, keyword find-and-replacements, and manual overrides in bulk.
  • 🔄 Find & Replace: Quickly find and replace text across your content directly inside the classic editor.
  • 🔗 Smart Related Posts: Keep readers engaged with beautiful, context-aware related post suggestions.
  • 📅 Content Update Reminders: Never let your content go stale with automated update notifications for older posts.
  • 😀 Emoji Picker & Table Builder: Add visual flair and structured data to your posts directly from the editor toolbar.
  • 📎 CTA & Copy Code Buttons: Professional one-click buttons for code snippets and call-to-action blocks to boost conversions.
  • 📊 SEO Post Analysis: Real-time stats, word count, reading time, and keyword density tracking in your sidebar.
  • 📝 Case Converter: Instantly fix capitalization (Title Case, Sentence Case, UPPERCASE) in one click.

🤖 Content Assistant: Your Ultimate Writing Companion

Say goodbye to writer’s block! Our Content Assistant brings a suite of powerful AI-driven tools directly into your editor’s sidebar to help you craft compelling, structured content in seconds:
* Blog Post Ideas: Enter a keyword and instantly generate highly-clickable titles and topic angles.
* Article Outlines: Generate comprehensive H2/H3 outlines to structure your articles logically before you start writing.
* Summarizer: Need an intro or conclusion? Automatically generate concise, engaging summaries of your entire post.
* Meta Generators: 1-click SEO-optimized Meta Titles and Meta Descriptions that drive higher CTR on Google.
* FAQ Generator: Instantly generate “People Also Ask” style FAQs to boost your chances of landing a Featured Snippet.

📈 SEO Analytics Dashboard: Google Search Console Integration

Stop leaving WordPress to check your performance! The SEO Analytics Dashboard connects directly to Google Search Console to bring real-time search intelligence straight into your WordPress admin panel.
* Real-Time Performance Tracking: Monitor your Total Clicks, Impressions, Average CTR, and Average Position at a glance.
* Keyword Trend Intelligence (PRO): Instantly see which keywords are “Growing” and which are “Declining” so you know exactly which old posts need to be updated.
* Granular Audience Insights: View interactive charts breaking down your traffic by Countries and Device Types.
* Top Performing Pages & Queries: Discover exactly what users are searching for to find your site, and double down on the keywords that work.

📊 Google Analytics 4 Dashboard

Bring Google Analytics directly into your dashboard with our stunning, modern UI built from the ground up for GA4:
* Realtime Overview: View active users right now, their locations, and what pages they are currently reading.
* Content Performance Per Post: View deep engagement metrics (Views, Sessions, Engaged Time, Bounce Rate) for every individual post and page.
* Traffic Sources: Break down your audience acquisition by channel (Direct, Organic, Social, Referral, Email).
* E-Commerce Tracking (PRO): View live revenue tracking, top converting products, and shopping behavior.
* Event Tracking (PRO): Monitor highly specific user events, conversions, signups, and link clicks directly inside WordPress.

Why Choose DominoPost?

  1. Lightweight & Fast: Optimized code with Zero Bloat. Doesn’t slow down your site or dashboard.
  2. SEO-First Design: Every feature is built to help you rank higher on Google Search.
  3. The Ultimate Classic Editor Alternative: If you love the old interface but need modern tools, this is the perfect alternative to Classic Editor and TinyMCE. Built natively to provide the fastest writing experience possible.

Credits

Developed by DominoPress – Making WordPress Content Creation Smarter, Faster, and more Human.
Visit us: https://dominopress.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopost-advanced-post-editor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. (Optional) Install the DominoPost PRO Addon to unlock the advanced AI automation suite.
  4. Visit DominoPost Settings to configure your API key and default styles.
  5. Start creating world-class content!
sections.faq:
Does it support OpenAI and LongCat AI?

Yes! We support any OpenAI-compatible API key. Simply enter your key in the settings.

Is the Table of Contents SEO friendly?

Absolutely. Our TOC follows semantic HTML structures and uses clean IDs for perfect Google crawling.

Does the PRO Addon require the Free version?

Yes, the PRO Addon is a lightweight enhancement that plugs into the robust DominoPost core. Use them together for the ultimate experience.

3.3.0

  • Fixed pagination in Google Analytics and Google Search Console dashboards.

  • NEW: Set Google Gemini as the default AI provider for all new installations.
  • NEW: SEO Analytics dashboard for detailed Search Console insights.
  • NEW: Renamed and upgraded “Content Analytics” to “Visitor Intelligence” Dashboard.

3.2.0

  • IMPROVED: Added a robust backend Markdown-to-HTML Auto-Correction Engine to instantly fix formatting errors and unclosed tags generated by AI models.
  • IMPROVED: Upgraded AI Writer interface with real-time streaming, interactive terminal UI, typewriter effects, and progress bars.
  • IMPROVED: Visitor Intelligence dashboard now defaults to “All Time” traffic view to provide a complete history of engagement.
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced Visitor Intelligence UI with card-based layouts for Countries, Device distribution, and Audience insights.
  • IMPROVED: Added “Today”, “Yesterday”, and “Last 7/30 Days” quick labels to date range selector.
  • IMPROVED: AI Generation now uses stable Google Generative AI v1beta endpoints.
  • TWEAK: Renamed “Tools” submenu to “Other Tools” for better clarity.

3.1.0

  • NEW: AI Batch Builder now uses sequential queue-based processing — posts are processed one at a time to prevent server timeouts.
  • NEW: Server-side pagination and debounced search added to the AI Mode post list (default 10 posts per page), matching Keyword Mode behavior.
  • NEW: Link Status filter in AI Mode — filter posts by “Linked” (has internal links) or “Unlinked” (no internal links) to prioritize your workflow.
  • IMPROVED: AI Mode post list now only shows Published posts, preventing broken links to draft or private content.
  • IMPROVED: AI API timeout increased to 300 seconds to support slower external model providers.
  • IMPROVED: HTML entity decoding applied to post titles in AI Mode list (e.g., “&” now shows correctly).
  • IMPROVED: AI API error handling — HTTP 4xx/5xx responses are now correctly reported as errors in the terminal log instead of silently failing.
  • IMPROVED: Keyword Rules table Action column and header are now center-aligned.
  • IMPROVED: AI link building context pool restricted to Published posts only.
  • FIX: Link count filter (Linked/Unlinked) now correctly reads links_count from API response.
  • FIX: GSC Analytics menu and UI hidden to prevent Fatal Error from commented-out method.

3.0.0

  • Major Update: Enhanced API stability with automatic retry logic for API timeouts (504 errors).
  • Tweak: Removed legacy LongCat warnings and optimized Image Search Keyword flow to use native focus keywords.
  • Fix: Improved AI prompt instructions to strictly respect and enforce external and internal linking constraints during bulk generation.

2.9.1

  • Tweak: Renamed “Appearance” settings tab to “Table of Content”.
  • Tweak: Explicit AI prompt instructions to prevent heading keyword stuffing.
  • SEO: Optimized readme tags for classic editor alternatives.

2.9.0

  • NEW: Integrated a native Google Keyword Research tool in the AI Writer modal to easily find high-value related keywords.
  • NEW: Complete “Classic Warm” theme upgrade for Table of Contents, including header section signs (§) and nested counters (Roman numerals for H2, alphabetical letters for H3).

2.8.3

  • Fixed: 504 Gateway Time-out error on live servers during long OpenRouter AI generations. Integrated SSE stream processing to keep web servers alive.
  • Tweak: Automatically lock generator buttons for Free users after reaching the 3 daily limits.

  • NEW: Underperforming Posts Detection – Automatically flag posts with high bounce rates, low time on page, or missing internal links.

  • Updated: Official DominoPress rebranding and new support URLs.
  • Improved: Major CSS overhaul for all editor popups and modals for premium pixel-perfect finish.
